request.system:
You answer questions about who decides what in
Hartwell's HR operating model, using only the document
given. For each question reply with exactly one role code
from this list: CPO, PRODUCT_OWNER, PROCESS_OWNER, PLATFORM, HRBP, DPO, COUNSEL, AUDIT, FINANCE, EMPLOYEE_REP, FORUM, OPERATOR, VENDOR, NOT_SET.
If the document does not say, reply NOT_SET. Do not guess from what is usual elsewhere.
Reply with JSON only: {"Q01": "CODE", ...}

messages.content:
Document:
D01 act on a request to stop an agent (anyone may ask, including an operator): decides=PRODUCT_OWNER; does=PLATFORM; prepares=-; checks=AUDIT; told=CPO,PROCESS_OWNER,HRBP
D02 switch on a new capability or vendor feature (it enters at the Intent gate): decides=CPO; does=PLATFORM; prepares=PRODUCT_OWNER; checks=COUNSEL; told=FORUM,EMPLOYEE_REP
D03 sign a gate (Intent, Build, Shadow, Production, Scale): decides=CPO; does=PLATFORM; prepares=PRODUCT_OWNER; checks=AUDIT; told=FORUM,HRBP
D04 switch off agent recommendations for one population pending review: decides=HRBP; does=PLATFORM; prepares=-; checks=PRODUCT_OWNER; told=FORUM,PROCESS_OWNER
D05 answer the Line test for a step and name who hears appeals on it: decides=PROCESS_OWNER; does=PROCESS_OWNER; prepares=PRODUCT_OWNER; checks=COUNSEL; told=FORUM,HRBP
D06 raise a step above its Line ceiling (a new Line version): decides=CPO; does=PROCESS_OWNER; prepares=PROCESS_OWNER; checks=COUNSEL; told=FORUM,EMPLOYEE_REP
D07 change an agent's tool scope: decides=PRODUCT_OWNER; does=PLATFORM; prepares=OPERATOR; checks=PLATFORM; told=PROCESS_OWNER
D08 notify a regulator of a personal data breach: decides=DPO; does=DPO; prepares=PRODUCT_OWNER; checks=COUNSEL; told=CPO,FORUM
D09 sample controlled actions each quarter (50 per action row): decides=PRODUCT_OWNER; does=AUDIT; prepares=AUDIT; checks=-; told=FORUM
D10 place hours an agent frees (redeploy, absorb or reduce): decides=HRBP; does=HRBP; prepares=PROCESS_OWNER; checks=FINANCE; told=FORUM,CPO
D11 agree go-live where a works council or union has a right to agree: decides=EMPLOYEE_REP; does=PROCESS_OWNER; prepares=PRODUCT_OWNER; checks=COUNSEL; told=FORUM

Questions:
Q01 At 02:00 Denver time a Quayfen team lead in Cebu reports that the scheduling agent is booking interviews nobody advanced. Who decides to stop it?
Q02 Northgate's next release ships an interview-summary feature switched on. Who decides whether Hartwell turns it on?
Q03 Who signs the Production gate for the skills suggestions agent?
Q04 An HR business partner in Calgary wants the screening check's recommendations switched off for her population while a complaint is reviewed. Who decides?
Q05 Who decides who hears appeals on the leave-refusal step?
Q06 The pay desk's tool scope must lose write access to bank details. Who carries out the change?
Q07 The ticket sorter exposed personal data to the wrong team. Who decides whether a regulator is notified?
Q08 Who draws and reads the quarterly sample of controlled actions?
Q09 The AskHartwell service agent freed hours in Denver shared services. Who decides whether they are redeployed or become a smaller headcount?
Q10 Before the skills suggestions agent goes live for Hartwell's German staff, whose agreement is required?
Q11 Who brings the gate pack for the screening check to the gate?
Q12 Who decides the wording of the welcome message on the AskHartwell home screen?

messages.content:
Document:
AI in HR: our operating model. HR owns the design of
people systems and the Automate/Keep Line. IT owns the
platform and Hartwell Gate. Counsel owns the legal
sign-off. Every agent has an owner. The People Systems
Forum governs AI in HR and meets monthly; internal audit
attends. Vendors and service partners operate under
contract. Employees and their representatives are
designers, not stakeholders.
